tasks.label: Zephyr: Build
args: source $HOME/zephyrproject/zephyr-env.sh && cd ${workspaceFolder} && west build -p auto -b stm32f4_disco .

tasks.label: Zephyr: Pristine Build
args: source $HOME/zephyrproject/zephyr-env.sh && cd ${workspaceFolder} && west build -p always -b stm32f4_disco .

tasks.label: Zephyr: Flash
args: source $HOME/zephyrproject/zephyr-env.sh && cd ${workspaceFolder} && west flash --runner openocd --cmd-pre-init "reset_config none separate" --cmd-pre-init "adapter speed 1000"
